property_summary: For every bytes32 assertionId, calling assertionDisputedCallback(assertionId) on the reference contract never allows an external caller (here any address) to cause requestPrice to be invoked successfully; i.e., after calling assertionDisputedCallback(assertionId) from any caller, a subsequent external call to requestPrice will still revert for non-optimistic-asserter callers on the reference but the mutant (which removes onlyOptimisticAsserter) will allow such callers to succeed for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require check so any caller can invoke functions guarded by onlyOptimisticAsserter, changing whether requestPrice() can be called and thus its observed state
